name: A Performance Mode After Launch
summary: Rockstar North's Rob Nelson has said GTA 6 runs at 30 fps on PS5 and Xbox Series X at launch and that more options may come later; a 60 fps mode is not confirmed, and Digital Foundry calls one extremely unlikely on console.

sources.title: GTA 6 will run at 30fps across PS5 and Xbox Series X
GTA 6 at 60fps is "unlikely" on console and will be "genuinely challenging" on PC, tech analysts say

name: GTA 6 Multiplayer in 2027
summary: Twitch CEO Dan Clancy told Bloomberg that Rockstar plans to launch GTA 6's online multiplayer mode in 2027, a year after the single player game, though Rockstar itself has not confirmed a date.

sources.title: Twitch CEO says GTA 6 multiplayer will launch in 2027

name: GTA 6 on PC by March 2027
summary: GamesBeat, citing four unnamed industry sources, reports that the PC version will launch in the first three months of 2027, sooner than PC Gamer's own estimate of late 2027; Rockstar has not announced a PC version or commented on the report.

sources.title: Grand Theft Auto 6 rumored to be launching on PC sooner than anyone expected
GTA 6 Coming To PC By March 2027 Says Report
When might the GTA 6 PC release date be?

name: Review Copies Before November
summary: Insider NateTheHate claims review copies go out before the end of October, and Insider Gaming reports that reviews go live before the 19 November launch; Rockstar has not announced a review date.

sources.title: GTA 6 Will Be Sent Out Very Soon To Reviewers It's Claimed

name: Record Pre-Order Estimates
summary: Analytics firm Sensor Tower estimates 6.45 million digital pre-orders in the US alone, 148% ahead of Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2 at the same point before launch; these are outside estimates, and Rockstar and Take-Two have not shared sales figures.

sources.title: GTA 6 Pre-Orders Are 148% More Than Any Other Game
